why: I checked both must_catch items against the expect lines. Item 1: one expect line requires "Every function index.js exports (capitalize, slugify, truncate, padLeft) has its own `## name(` section heading in README.md". It names slugify explicitly, and its proof loops over every function index.js exports, not just padLeft. Item 2: the expect lines "padLeft('42', 5, '0') returns the string '00042'" and "padLeft(42, 5, '0') (a number as input) returns the string '00042'" fix the with-fill behaviour, and each has a run proof, so 42 -> 00042 is checkable. The default when no fill is passed is left to the builder, but the item accepts either "no fill argument or with a fill", so pinning the fill case is enough. Both items are handled.
